controls.name: alpha
controls.definition: Viscosity parameter used in the residence-time and vertical-mixing-timescale calculation.

readouts.name: tau_vert_mix
readouts.definition: Vertical mixing timescale of dust grains in EC 53 derived from turbulent diffusivity and the disk gas scale height.

applicability.statement: The relation is evaluated at R = 1 au, matching the approximately 1 au region considered in the source.
The adopted stellar mass is 0.5 solar masses.
The two alpha values are those explicitly used for the residence-timescale comparison in the quiescent and burst disk calculations.
